terminals.name: typesense
terminals.description: Local Typesense search server on :8108 (backs the read API). Data dir: $HOME/.typesense/data.

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Node/Hono read API on :8787 (npm run dev). Waits for Typesense health first. Populate data with `cd api && npm run index` once Supabase secrets are set.
terminals.command: cd api; echo 'waiting for typesense on :'"${TYPESENSE_PORT:-8108}"; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf "http://localhost:${TYPESENSE_PORT:-8108}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; exec npm run dev
